content.value_statement: Jest setup and testing patterns can become inconsistent across projects. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code improve Jest and Vitest tests with focused references and templates.
actual_capabilities: Guides Jest configuration for Node, jsdom, TypeScript transforms, and coverage thresholds.
Provides matcher, mock, timer, lifecycle, and async testing references.
Offers React Testing Library examples for forms, hooks, and user events.
Includes MSW examples for mocked API success and failure cases.
Supplies a shell helper to inspect Jest setup in a local project.
Provides a reusable TypeScript test file template.
limitations: Does not execute tests unless the user or agent runs commands.
Does not replace project-specific test architecture review.
The setup checker only covers common Jest files and package entries.
Examples require adaptation to local components and dependency versions.

use_cases.title: Build React Component Tests
use_cases.description: Create tests with React Testing Library, user-event, and async assertions for user flows.

use_cases.title: Validate Node Test Setup
use_cases.description: Check Jest configuration, TypeScript transforms, mocks, timers, and coverage expectations for service code.

use_cases.title: Standardize Test Reviews
use_cases.description: Use shared Jest guidance to review mocks, snapshots, CI settings, and flaky test patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Jest Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the jest-testing skill to write a unit test for [function or component]. Include setup, one happy path, and one error case.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Failing Mock
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the jest-testing skill to review this failing mock test: [paste test]. Explain the likely cause and update the mock strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Add React Testing Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the jest-testing skill to design React Testing Library tests for [component]. Cover rendering, user events, loading, and error states.

prompt_templates.title: Harden Jest Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the jest-testing skill to review this Jest configuration and package setup. Recommend transforms, setup files, coverage thresholds, and CI changes.

output_examples.input: Review my Jest setup for a TypeScript React app.
output: Identifies missing jest-dom setup and recommends a setup file.
Checks whether TypeScript transforms match the project compiler.
Suggests coverage thresholds and a CI test command.

output_examples.input: Help me test a login form with loading and error states.
output: Plans accessible queries for fields, buttons, alerts, and status text.
Uses user-event for typing and submission behavior.
Adds mocked success and failure API responses with MSW.

output_examples.input: My Jest mock is not applied before import.
output: Explains import order and module cache behavior.
Recommends module-level mocks or resetModules for isolated cases.
Keeps assertions focused on observable behavior.

best_practices: Prefer accessible Testing Library queries before test IDs.
Mock external APIs at the boundary with MSW or module mocks.
Keep setup, cleanup, and timers explicit to reduce flaky tests.
anti_patterns: Avoid large snapshots for behavior that should use direct assertions.
Avoid testing private implementation details instead of visible outcomes.
Avoid committing focused or skipped tests without a clear reason.

faq.question: Does this skill support Vitest?
faq.answer: Yes. Many examples apply to Vitest because its API is compatible with Jest.

faq.question: Can it run my tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and helper resources. Commands run only when requested or approved by the agent environment.

faq.question: Does it cover React Testing Library?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for queries, user events, hooks, loading states, and error states.

faq.question: Can it help with Jest configuration?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers environments, transforms, setup files, module aliases, and coverage thresholds.

faq.question: Does it replace test quality analysis?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Jest mechanics and patterns, not broad test strategy assessment.

faq.question: Is there a setup checker?
faq.answer: Yes. The included shell script inspects common local Jest files and package entries.
